engine.implementation: TorchRebo2Scr (PyTorch autograd port of Atomistica Rebo2Scr kernel)
engine.parameterization: Brenner 2002 + Pastewka 2008 screening; Atomistica default tables; dihedral=False
citations: D. W. Brenner, O. A. Shenderova, J. A. Harrison, S. J. Stuart, B. Ni, S. B. Sinnott, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 14, 783 (2002).
L. Pastewka, P. Pou, R. Perez, P. Gumbsch, M. Moseler, Phys. Rev. B 78, 161402(R) (2008).
L. Pastewka, A. Klemenz, P. Gumbsch, M. Moseler, Phys. Rev. B 87, 205410 (2013).
Atomistica, https://github.com/Atomistica/atomistica (L. Pastewka et al.), version 1.2.7.
engine.units: eV, Angstrom; 2D stress in eV/A^2 (x16.0218 = N/m)

amendment.reason: The first completed pilot stopped by stress collapse while spanning; its final frame has force residual 0.27796 eV/Angstrom despite a true inherited FIRE flag. Check whether the criterion survives further relaxation of this recorded endpoint.
amendment.scope: One fixed-cell endpoint diagnostic. Preserve the original trajectory and termination; do not splice relaxed states into it or infer a corrected loading path.
amendment.interpretation: Compare topology, force/transverse residuals and stress against the frozen preceding running peak. Passing fixed-cell checks does not validate the full loading path or a zero-transverse-stress endpoint.
